picks.rationale: OpenDLSS-NR brings DLSS 5-style neural rendering to Vulkan, RTX 40 and browsers, so developers outside NVIDIA's stack can now use it. This is the only DLSS 5 pick, per the cross-section rule.
picks.excerpt: OpenDLSS-NR reimplements DLSS 5's neural rendering in Vulkan, hitting 7.8 ms at 1080p on an RTX 4070 and even running in browsers. It opens the AI 're-lighting' filter to hardware and developers outside NVIDIA's official stack.

picks.rationale: An AI agent built a complete RTX path tracer in about an hour, a concrete sign that agentic coding now reaches real-time rendering tools for game developers.
picks.excerpt: A developer used Anthropic's Claude to build a complete RTX-accelerated path tracer in about an hour, with the AI handling system-level graphics engineering from scratch. Wccftech frames it as a sign of autonomous AI coding reaching real-time rendering tools.

picks.rationale: A Steam showcase that keeps out generative-AI games makes 'no genAI' a curation and discovery rule, which directly affects how indie teams position their games.
picks.excerpt: Steam's week-long Punk Games Showcase starts October 9 with 100+ curated games out of 400 submissions, explicitly filtering out titles that used generative AI. Curation by 'no genAI' is becoming a storefront feature in its own right.

picks.rationale: A major studio, Remedy, uses in-game writing to satirize AI slop, showing how AAA teams now take a stance on AI inside the game itself.
picks.excerpt: Remedy's Control Resonant, confirmed as made without AI, includes a collectible, 'The Great Copy Battle', a deliberately awful movie script that lampoons generative-AI slop. It joins a wave of games using in-world writing to take a stance on AI-made content.

picks.rationale: A new design idea: AI companionship as both the theme and the interface of a game, written entirely by hand. It adds a fourth outlet and a different angle.
picks.excerpt: LOVE alt delete is an upcoming psychological-horror visual novel where you beta-test 'MUSE' romance chatbots, typing freely and roping in a second chatbot to help court the first, all without using generative AI itself. AI companionship as theme and interface, hand-authored as craft.
